method: scripts/audit/make-dock-over-tiles.mjs: the brightest thumbnail of the set under each dock label and icon, WCAG contrast of the label's own ink read from a photograph with its text hidden; the foot picture with and without the dock

notes: before = the glass at its old tint, 0.46, set on this build with the page's --dock-tint (so the picture behind and the build are the same as for after); the old soft black drop shadow lies outside the glass and never touched a label, so it does not enter the number.
after = tint 0.58 and no drop shadow. 0.55 is 4.48 at 1440 by 900, so 0.58 is the smallest of the steps tried that holds 4.5 to 1 at all three sizes.
contrast is the worst pixel of each label's box (not the mean): the label's own ink over the picture with its text hidden, WCAG relative luminance.
white is a pure white tile, the bound no picture can pass; the dock is not asked to hold it.
a second full run of the final build (label 'final' in the work folder, not kept here) gave the same worst contrasts: 4.73, 4.76, 4.93.
